author: claude

generation.prompt:
Pixel art sprite sheet of the EXACT same character as attached image 1 — a finished pixel-art sprite.
Copy it pixel for pixel in style: same very large chunky pixels, same 16-colour palette, same dark outline,
same proportions (about 4 heads tall), same face. Long pale-blonde hair in two thick braids, a dark iron circlet, a grey fur-trimmed cloak over black and silver knotwork armour, a rune-etched iron breastplate and plated armour skirt, heavy black boots with silver trim, a short-hafted dark iron hammer with a rune-etched head held at the image-right side, faint lightning-white glow.
Keep decoration as simple as image 1 — do not add new details. Image 2 is only a colour and face reference; do not copy its painterly style.

Sheet layout: portrait canvas 2160 x 3840, 4 frames in a 2 x 2 grid (cell 1080 x 1920), read left to right, top to bottom.
In every cell the character is the same size (about 125 pixels tall on the sprite's own pixel grid, each sprite pixel
drawn as a crisp 13 x 13 square), centred horizontally, with both feet on the same baseline near the bottom of the cell.
Every frame faces the same direction as described below. Hard edges only: no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, no dithering noise.
Transparent background. No grid lines, no cell borders, no numbers, no labels, no text, no ground, no shadow, no motion lines, no extra characters.

IDLE animation, 4 frames. Same standing pose as image 1, three-quarter view turned slightly toward the viewer's right, arms relaxed.
Changes between frames are tiny (1-2 sprite pixels): frame 1 = exactly image 1; frame 2 = slight breath in, shoulders and hair 1 pixel up;
frame 3 = same as frame 2 but eyes closed (blink); frame 4 = back between frame 2 and frame 1.
Feet never move. The loop 4 -> 1 must be seamless.
